prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic high-angle smartphone selfie of a young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, with ethnicity unspecified, standing outdoors on a busy modern urban pedestrian plaza. She has a softly oval face with a small tapered chin, smooth fair skin with a luminous slightly pink-toned complexion, large almond-shaped dark brown eyes enhanced by defined upper eyeliner, long curled lashes, subtle rose-pink eyeshadow, softly shaped straight brows, a petite straight nose, and naturally full pink lips with a gentle satin finish. Her expression is calm, sweet, and composed, with a faint closed-mouth smile while looking directly into the camera. A tiny beauty mark is visible near one cheek. Her long, straight, very dark brown-to-black hair falls well below her chest, worn loose with wispy full bangs across her forehead and soft face-framing strands.

She holds the camera above her head at arm’s length, creating a dramatic downward selfie perspective. Her upper body is slightly angled while her face turns upward toward the lens. Her opposite arm is raised outward near shoulder level, hand visible at the edge of the frame with long pointed manicured nails. Recreate her outfit faithfully: a fitted, semi-sheer white ribbed long-sleeve top with a wide asymmetrical/off-shoulder neckline, gently gathered fabric, slightly flared ruffled cuffs, and a softly ruffled lower hem; underneath, a light blue-gray bra is visibly seen through the translucent fabric exactly as in the reference. Pair it with a short light-gray pleated mini skirt, sheer black tights, and tall fitted black boots. A black handbag hangs near her side.

The setting is a gray stone-paved public walkway with polished granite steps and curved architectural surfaces, stainless-steel railings decorated with small pale pink triangular pennant flags, and several casually dressed pedestrians partially visible in the upper background, naturally cropped by the composition. Include shopping bags and personal belongings near the lower side of the frame. Use soft overcast daylight with gentle facial fill, minimal harsh shadowing, realistic skin texture, subtle specular highlights in the eyes, and natural reflections on hair and metal railings. Shot with a modern flagship smartphone ultra-wide lens around 24–26mm equivalent, close focusing distance, slight perspective distortion characteristic of an overhead selfie, crisp facial detail, moderate background sharpness, realistic HDR, subdued gray urban tones contrasted with clean whites, soft pink skin tones, deep black hair, cinematic neutral color grading, extremely realistic photographic detail, no text, no watermark, vertical composition, 9:16.
